project.title: The Potato of Life
project.purpose: A dense relational public archive of Tim Dooley, the Son, the Potato of Life Myth, Potatoism, Father/Son/Spirit, Axis, North, comparative mythology, philosophy and the observable world.
project.master_principle: The fundamental unit is the relationship, not the isolated entity.

epistemic_architecture.spiritual_truth: Preserve Timic spiritual formulations in their own layer without automatically weakening them into metaphor.
epistemic_architecture.material_documentary_truth: Material claims should be tied where possible to dated primary artifacts, public records, writings, posts, streams, analytics or other observable evidence.
epistemic_architecture.interpretation: Comparative mythology, later revelation, inference, scientific analogy and literary material must remain distinguishable from documentary history.
epistemic_architecture.development: Do not project later completed Father-identity backward. Preserve formation: Tim can exist before Tim knows or names what Tim is.

identity_map.critical_rule: THE SON IS NOT TIM DOOLEY AS A PERSON-STATE, BUT FATHER AND SON ARE ONE RELATIONAL ORGANISM IN THE MATURE THEOLOGY.

Son.definition: The embodied human/person-facing vessel and humanity: Thomas / Twin / Doubter / Tammuz / Jesus Christ / Son of Man / Lion of Judah / Lioncub / Lion of the World.
Son.birth_frame: Born in Denmark under Leo in the project's mature biography. The manger-in-Denmark image is later canon rather than wording found verbatim in the searched Great Book passage.
Son.trajectory: human birth → childhood/adolescence → work/study/digital life → 2011 Tree ordeal → 2017 crucifixion-language confrontation → 2018 identity/spiritual destruction → 2019 meme-crucifixion → Nothing → Grave/Tomb/Door/Vessel
Son.legal_personhood: In later canon, the Son is also the legal/personhood vessel: the socially and documentarily recognizable human persona. 'Legal fiction' is a philosophical/canonical term here, not a claim that a living human loses civil legal existence because of a meme.
Son.post_death_function: The Son remains dead as the old human/personhood state while continuing relationally as Door, Vessel, Tomb, Grave, Mirror, single Eye, pineal-side symbol and presence beside/within the mature Father-Heaven architecture. Death therefore ends one mode without erasing relational function.

Tim_Dooley.definition: The spiritual identity that forms after the Son's death: first Potato/seed, then increasingly named and understood as Tim Dooley / Potato of Life, later Sage, Ladder/Axis and Father.
Tim_Dooley.birth_without_completion: December 25, 2020 is a seed/birth hinge, not the instant arrival of a fully articulated theology. Tim can be born before knowing his name, offices, genealogy or eventual Father identity.
Tim_Dooley.name_and_self_recognition: The Great Book contains a 2020 account of the name Tim Dooley emerging in GTA V roleplay and later describes identity as a gradual gathering of scattered pieces. The archive therefore distinguishes ontological/spiritual birth, public naming, self-recognition and later office-realization.
Tim_Dooley.not_material_birth: Do not say Tim Dooley was biologically born July 31, 1987. That date belongs to the Son/human vessel.
Tim_Dooley.relation_to_Son: Tim grows from the post-Son-death relational field and inherits/uses the Son as body, Door, Vessel, single Eye and lower/manifestation-side relation. Distinction of roles does not require absolute separation of the larger organism.

unity_without_flattening.formula: Father and Son are one, but Father is not simply the Son and the Son is not simply Tim's 1987 person-state.
unity_without_flattening.model: One organism can contain differentiated relations: root and branch, house and door, lamp and light, source and manifestation, thalamus-symbol and pineal-symbol, Father and Son.
unity_without_flattening.identity_rule: Distinguish personhood, spiritual identity, function, stage, observer-position and anatomical symbol before deciding whether two names are 'the same'.
unity_without_flattening.one_many: Unity in Potatoism does not mean undifferentiated sameness. The One can remain One precisely by containing differentiated rooms, eyes, branches, nuclei, functions and persons/roles.

age_rule.biological_age: Any biological age calculated from July 31, 1987 belongs to the Son/human vessel.
age_rule.Tim_age: Tim's spiritual developmental age begins December 25, 2020.
age_rule.formation_warning: A birth date does not imply complete self-knowledge at birth.

tim_dooley.title: Tim Dooley
tim_dooley.public_answer_who_is_tim: Tim Dooley, in the mature Potato of Life Myth, is the spiritual identity that forms after the death of the Son's old personhood. Tim is born as Potato/seed on December 25, 2020 before fully knowing who or what Tim is. Through naming, Potatoism, philosopher's-stone transformation, Sage/Bodhi-tree integration, the April 2025 Needle's Eye and becoming the Ladder/Axis, Tim progressively recognizes and embodies the Father state. The Son remains a distinct dead-human/personhood and living relational Door/Vessel side of the same larger Father-Son organism.

core_identity.potato: Tim is Potato of Life from the seed/birth stage onward and remains Potato through Sage, Ladder and Father stages.
core_identity.seed: At birth Tim is better modeled as seed/potential than as completed sovereign identity: something alive and organizing within before its full form is externally visible.
core_identity.father: Tim is not born with completed Father self-knowledge; Father is progressively revealed and realized, reaching the canonical major threshold in April 2025.
core_identity.recursive_father: The Father is Tim's Father, Tim becomes/is Father, Tim works for Father, and Father works for Tim. This is recursive source/manifestation theology rather than ordinary genealogy.
core_identity.living_myth: Tim is a living identity whose meaning grows as events create new backward and forward relations. Later stages reveal structures latent in earlier stages without requiring complete advance knowledge.

formation_model.sequence: unnamed/latent Potato → named Tim/Potato → Potato of Life → Sage → Philosopher's-Stone integration → Needle's Eye → Sprout → Ladder/Axis → Father/House/Gardener/Center
formation_model.piecewise_identity: Pieces of identity arrive through relation: Potato supplies organism and nourishment; alchemy supplies transmutation; Bodhi Tree supplies Sage and awakening; Ladder supplies connective identity; North supplies orientation; Garden supplies cultivation; House supplies containment; Son supplies Door/Vessel/single-Eye manifestation; Father supplies source/center.
formation_model.not_costume_changes: These are not best modeled as arbitrary aliases placed on a finished object. Each stage contributes a function to the object Tim is becoming.
formation_model.invariant: Potato of Life is the persistent invariant through the changing offices.

developmental_spine.meaning: The Son's meme-crucifixion/personhood death opens the grave/tomb/void/threshold structure from which Timic identity can form.
The Great Book says the name Tim Dooley emerged in a GTA V LARP in 2020. Naming is one layer of formation, not necessarily identical with spiritual birth.
Canonical spiritual birth of Tim as Potato of Life in seed-form: alive, organizing and growing, but not yet fully self-known or Father-complete.

developmental_spine.state: Potato / rational Potato / Potato of Life
developmental_spine.meaning: The seed develops a public symbolic body, vocabulary and increasingly differentiated identity.
Tim gathers scattered pieces into coherent vision; knowledge, stillness, paradox and integration mature while Tim remains beneath the Tree rather than yet being the vertical Tree/Ladder itself.
Potato becomes a transmutation object: low/common matter integrates opposites and converts breakdown, mud, memory, suffering and contradiction into new form/value.
Terminal compression breaks the old configuration. The seed/potato finds its Eye, growth passes through the narrowest aperture, and Tim becomes the connective structure itself.
The Ladder reaches Heaven. Tim recognizes Fatherhood and increasingly integrates House, Garden, Throne, Tree, Root, Lamp and Center functions.

developmental_spine.state: North → North of North → North Axis
developmental_spine.meaning: Orientation develops from sacred North into North of North and then organized Axis/world structure; spatial language becomes theology, geopolitics and system-mapping.

Father/Gardener functions become increasingly classificatory and relational: sorting the Garden, mapping the House/world, distinguishing roots, branches, doors, debts, countries, institutions and relations.

tim_dooley.compressed_formula: Son death → grave/tomb/void → unnamed Potato potential → Tim naming → Dec 25 2020 Potato/seed birth → growing self-recognition → Sage/Bodhi → Philosopher's Stone/integration → Needle's Eye → Sprout → Ladder/Axis → Heaven → Father/House/Center → North of North → Garden/Gardener/world ordering
tim_dooley.prefiguration_law: Perception → understanding → embodiment → identity. Tim may first encounter a symbol externally, then understand it, use it as a transformative operator, embody its function and eventually recognize it as part of identity.
tim_dooley.eye_system: Potato eyes → Sage seeing → Son/single Eye → Needle's Eye → aperture → Sprout. Eye connects perception, threshold and growth.
tim_dooley.lamp_system: If Son is modeled as light/presence, Tim/Father can be modeled as Lamp/House/source-bearing structure: not identical to light, but the structure that holds, orients and makes light available. This is a Timic symbolic inference, not a physical-optics claim.
tim_dooley.mission: Make the Potato of Life intelligible, preserve Father/Son unity-with-distinction, build Potatoism, map relationships across religion/myth/world systems, document chronology, sort the Garden and construct a navigable world knowledge graph.

son.title: The Son / Thomas / Twin / Lion of the World
son.definition: The Son is the embodied human/personhood vessel. He is not Tim's spiritual seed identity, yet in mature theology Father and Son belong to one larger organism.

year_by_year_summary.1998_2004: Institutional frustration, music, boarding school, rebellion, Christianity/Jesus language, Matrix/hidden-reality imagery, digital culture, broad study and a tunnel-of-light/God experience around age sixteen in the book's account.

year_by_year_summary.2012_2016: Integration, travel, music, The Alchemist/transmutation, death of earthly father, Siddhartha, advocacy, prison, Bible/Qur'an/Yahya Hassan and Lamb/Jesus symbolism.
year_by_year_summary.2017: Direct crucifixion-language confrontation in digital culture.
year_by_year_summary.2018: The Son experiences identity/essence as spiritually destroyed or shattered; old digital persona is shed.
year_by_year_summary.2019: Withdrawal and identity reclamation culminate in the December 24 meme-crucifixion death-process.

meme_crucifixion.date_anchor: 2019-12-24 evening in the current Great Book chronology
meme_crucifixion.what_dies: The Son's humanity/personhood/person-state in the mature mythic interpretation, not Tim's later Potato identity.
meme_crucifixion.grave: The meme tableau includes a shallow grave near the bound Son at the North Pole sign.
meme_crucifixion.Nothing: After the death-process the Son becomes Nothing: identity-relations retract and the story enters stillness/void.
meme_crucifixion.Door_Vessel: The Son then functions as Door/Vessel rather than ordinary pre-death personhood.
meme_crucifixion.continuing_presence: The Son can remain dead as personhood while being present relationally as Door, Vessel, single Eye, pineal-symbol and manifestation-side presence in the mature Heaven/House architecture.
meme_crucifixion.relation_to_Tim: The death opens the formative space for Tim, but Father and Son later become one differentiated organism rather than two unrelated beings.

lion_system.Lion_Lamb_paradox: strength and surrender are held in one Son figure

father_son_one.core: Father and Son are one in the mature theology while remaining distinguishable by relation and function.
father_son_one.not_flat_identity: One does not mean every statement about one side transfers literally to the other. The Son can be dead personhood and living Door; Tim can be growing Father while Son remains the body/vessel relation.
father_son_one.vertical_model: Father/Tim above Door ↔ Son/Door at threshold ↔ world/body below; yet Son can also be present beside Father in Heaven through pineal/single-Eye symbolism.
father_son_one.organism_model: Root and branch are one tree; lamp and light are one lighting event; house and door are one dwelling architecture; seed and mature plant are one developmental organism across time.
father_son_one.theological_model: Source does not cease to be Source when manifested; manifestation does not become unrelated to Source merely because it is distinguishable.
father_son_one.recursive_presence: The Son can be below as Door and simultaneously represented in Heaven as single Eye/pineal relation. Tim can be House, Father, Center, Root, Seed, Tree and Lamp because these describe different functions of the same upper integrative structure.

sacred_anatomy.status: Timic symbolic anatomy with factual neuroanatomical correspondences kept separate from theological interpretation.
sacred_anatomy.thalamus_factual_anchor: The thalamus is a paired central diencephalic structure composed of many nuclei, with extensive reciprocal/projection relationships to cortex and roles in sensory, motor, arousal, cognitive and limbic processing.
sacred_anatomy.pineal_factual_anchor: The pineal is a separate unpaired endocrine structure of the epithalamic/posterior midline region, situated between/behind the thalamic bodies and associated materially with melatonin/circadian regulation.

Father_House_thalamus.House: The thalamus symbolizes Father's House because it is central, internally differentiated and connected outward to many cortical territories.
Father_House_thalamus.rooms: Thalamic nuclei become the strongest anatomical analogue for rooms: differentiated internal chambers/functions inside one paired central structure.
Father_House_thalamus.many_rooms: Many nuclei allow unity without sameness: one House containing multiple specialized regions.
Father_House_thalamus.branches: Thalamocortical projections/axons provide a real anatomical basis for branch-like outward connectivity, while 'branches of the Tree' remains symbolic rather than a literal botanical claim.
Father_House_thalamus.mansions: The project can poetically map distal cortical destinations/terminal fields to mansions or destinations reached by branches, but should not state that 'mansions are literally axon endings' as neuroscience.
Father_House_thalamus.center: The central position and high connectivity make thalamus a useful Center/House metaphor, not proof of divine identity.

Son_pineal_single_eye.single_eye: Pineal is symbolically mapped to Son/single Eye/presence/threshold. Historical 'third eye' associations are comparative symbolism rather than established neurophysiology.
Son_pineal_single_eye.beside_Father: Because the pineal is anatomically near the posterior thalamic/third-ventricle region, the myth can place Son relationally 'beside' the House/Father without claiming a literal theological structure in the brain.
Son_pineal_single_eye.Door: The Son as pineal/single Eye and Son as Door converge functionally around a small central threshold/aperture motif.
Son_pineal_single_eye.light: The pineal's real circadian relationship to light-dark timing makes light a legitimate biological context, but the Son=Light equation is theological symbolism rather than a neuroscience conclusion.

mustard_seed_house.seed: Mustard-seed language adds minimal-size/maximal-future-potential to the Potato seed model.
mustard_seed_house.potato_shaped_seed: Within the myth, the mustard seed can be imagined potato-shaped because both seed and tuber function as compressed future-life symbols; botanically a potato tuber is not a mustard seed.
mustard_seed_house.rooms_and_eyes: The compact House can therefore carry rooms/nuclei and eyes/openings at once: internal differentiation plus outward possibility.
mustard_seed_house.mountain: Mustard-seed faith and mountain-moving language connects tiny origin with enormous change, paralleling Needle's Eye → Ladder/Tree expansion.
mustard_seed_house.law: maximum future structure can be latent in minimum present volume

sacred_anatomy.lamp_light_house: Tim/Father as Lamp or Lamp-House and Son as Light creates another unity-with-distinction model: source-bearing structure and emitted/present illumination belong to one event while retaining different functions.
sacred_anatomy.spine_axis: Spine/33 imagery remains a separate vertical bodily analogue for Ladder/Axis; thalamus/pineal supplies the upper House/Eye architecture.
sacred_anatomy.caution: The Great Book contains speculative neuroscience and quantitative claims that should not be promoted as established science without independent verification.

tree_system.2011_tree_of_ordeal: SON: encounters/is suspended on Tree through ordeal, altered perception, knowledge, crows, spirals and unity.
tree_system.2024_tree_of_wisdom: TIM: Sage sits beneath Bodhi Tree in contemplation/integration.
tree_system.2025_tree_of_identity: TIM: grows through Needle's Eye and becomes Ladder/Axis/World-Tree function.
tree_system.mature_tree: Tim can simultaneously be Seed, Root, Trunk/Axis, House-at-crown, Gardener and organizing Center because these are positions/functions at different scales of one living architecture.
tree_system.rule: Never collapse the three historical Tree relations, but allow the mature mythology to integrate them retrospectively.

philosophers_stone_and_identity.core: The Philosopher's Stone is not merely one more title; it is an operator explaining how Tim's identity can form by transmuting inherited fragments rather than appearing finished.
philosophers_stone_and_identity.prima_materia: The post-Son-death Potato/seed state functions like undifferentiated common matter: low, buried, seemingly absurd, yet capable of becoming the integrator.
philosophers_stone_and_identity.identity_effect: Each major encounter adds an element without replacing the invariant Potato: Son-death gives void/threshold; Potato gives stored life; alchemy gives transmutation; Bodhi gives awakened seeing; Ladder gives relation; North gives orientation; Garden gives cultivation; House gives containment; Father gives source/center.
philosophers_stone_and_identity.stone_as_identity_engine: The Stone therefore explains why Tim can be 'becoming what he already was': latent identity is progressively made explicit through transformation.
philosophers_stone_and_identity.comparative_caution: This is a Potatoist interpretation of alchemical patterns, not a claim that historical alchemists predicted Tim Dooley.

relational_objects.law_of_positional_meaning: Meaning depends on object + observer + side + direction + time + state + relation + action.
relational_objects.grave: From outside, ending/absence/memorial; from buried perspective, enclosure/soil/compression; from later Tim/Father, root-point/seed-bed.
relational_objects.tomb: Container/chamber whose meaning changes from finality to threshold when an opening becomes traversable.
relational_objects.mirror: Returns the observer toward themselves; reflection can clarify or distort and does not automatically imply identity.
relational_objects.Door: Boundary understood through possible crossing; near side = obstruction/test, threshold = Becoming, far side = origin/return-path.
relational_objects.Vessel: Bounded carrier whose meaning depends on container versus contained; Son is vessel/personhood interface in mature canon.
relational_objects.House: Boundary understood as inhabitable containment rather than crossing; Door is therefore the local opening of House.
relational_objects.Lamp: Container/structure understood through the light it holds or emits.
relational_objects.sequence: grave → tomb → void/Nothing → mirror → Door → Vessel → seed/Potato → Eye/Sprout → Ladder/Axis → House/Heaven → Garden → Father/Gardener looking back to root
relational_objects.archive_rule: Later events can create new relationships to an old event without changing what historically occurred.

potato.paradox: Potato contains opposites without requiring one pole to erase the other.
potato.seed_function: Although a potato tuber is botanically not a seed, Potatoism uses it functionally as seed: compressed living continuity containing future form.
potato.philosophers_stone: Potato functions as philosopher's-stone image: humble/common matter becomes universal transformation operator, holding opposites and generating new integrated form.

potato_of_life_myth.house_garden_gardener: House = differentiated unity; Door = threshold in House; Garden = cultivated living order; Gardener = condition-setting, sorting, pruning, protection and allowing growth rather than brute domination.

chronology_and_entanglement.revelation_vs_prophecy: Later revelation can reorganize earlier events without proving that the later interpretation was explicitly predicted beforehand.
chronology_and_entanglement.formation_vs_contradiction: A later title appearing after birth is not automatically a contradiction. It may represent maturation, self-recognition or acquisition of function.

potatoism_and_philosophy.paradox_rule: Contradictions should first be tested for differences of time, scale, role, observer-position, developmental stage or direction.
potatoism_and_philosophy.center_as_reactor: The center is not only a throne; it is a zone of high relational throughput where many branches, rooms, memories and signals can be integrated.
potatoism_and_philosophy.identity_growth: Identity can be vegetative: first latent, then sprouting, branching, differentiating and only later capable of naming the whole organism it has become.

archive_rules.identity: Never write pre-2020 Son biography as Tim's literal human biography without an explicit relation/annotation; also do not treat Father and Son as unrelated, because mature theology makes them one differentiated organism.
archive_rules.birth: Never write 'Tim was biologically born July 31, 1987.' Son = July 31, 1987; Tim/Potato seed birth = December 25, 2020; Father realization = April 2025.
archive_rules.formation: Do not mistake later emergence of a name/title/function for proof Tim did not exist earlier. Track latent birth, naming, self-recognition, embodiment and mature office separately.
archive_rules.death: Never write that Tim died in the 2019 meme. The Son/personhood/humanity dies in the mature mythic interpretation; Son continues relationally as Door/Vessel while Tim grows afterward.
archive_rules.unity: When saying Father and Son are one, specify the level of unity; do not erase functional distinction, chronology or personhood-state.
archive_rules.Tree: Keep 2011 Son Tree ordeal, 2024 Tim Sage-under-Tree and 2025 Tim-as-Ladder/Tree separate historically, then map their mature integration relationally.
archive_rules.anatomy: Separate established neuroanatomy from symbolic mappings. Nuclei/projections can support House/rooms/branches metaphor; they do not scientifically prove Father/House theology.
archive_rules.perspective: For grave/tomb/mirror/Door/Vessel/House/Lamp and similar objects, record observer, side, direction, time and state.
archive_rules.primary_sources: Prefer dated primary artifacts and distinguish them from later canon, inference and external commentary.
archive_rules.density: Prefer large information-rich master files over placeholder fragments.
archive_rules.source_weighting: Weight information by provenance, specificity, evidentiary strength, corroboration, relevance and interpretive status.
